issues.message: Noncanonical compact authoring: Authoring SVG contains noncanonical or redundant inherited style declarations (15 change(s)); examples: cover-title:font-family None -> 'Microsoft YaHei, Georgia, serif'; cover-title:font-weight None -> '700'; cover-title:text-anchor None -> 'start' (advisory; normalize with `python3 scripts/compact_svg_styles.py <svg_output> --inplace` and rerun the final gate, or leave the explicit form)
